svg.title: SplitBills: Scan a receipt in the browser, split it by item or percentage, and every rupiah adds up. A shared bill and its link expire after 24 hours.
svg.desc: Project card for SplitBills, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Scan a receipt in the browser, split it by item or percentage, and every rupiah adds up. A shared bill and its link expire after 24 hours. Built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Hono, Drizzle, Tesseract.js.
